element.description: The element the session belongs to

building.description: Indicates if mark is in build process

x.description: Indicates x coordinate if type is point

y.description: Indicates y coordinate if type is point

showLabel.description: Not read by this element or `@pie-lib/graphing`.

from.description: Indicates where starts the mark if type is line, segment, ray, vector

to.description: Indicates where ends the mark if type is line, segment, ray, vector

middle.description: Labelled midpoint of a line, ray, segment, vector, circle or polygon mark

root.description: Indicated the root of mark if type is sine, parabola, absolute, exponential or circle

edge.description: Indicated the edge of mark if type is sine, parabola, absolute, exponential or circle

closed.description: Indicates if mark is closed if type is polygon, sine

points.description: Indicates all mark's points if type is polygon

MarkType.description: Kind of mark a graphing tool draws.

label.description: Label shown next to the point

MarkPoint.description: A point of a mark, labelled with the label tool.
